summary: Documents no longer have a Tabs component; side-by-side options are two Cards and folded detail is an Accordion.
details: A stored document cannot hold Tabs (none did), and a document that cannot be drawn now says only that it cannot be shown, without the schema's raw reason.
limitations: The document end-to-end spec was not run against this change because the local environment could not sign in; the unit tests, the typecheck and the Python gate were.
